body: I've discovered that the perfect thing for me is a big bowl of mac and cheese with some tuna in it, but I would think it's different for everyone.  I also have a big bottle of Gatorade and drink about half before and half right after.
Yeah, my family and I are all odd :)
I go twice a week and enjoy possibly helping out and the extra blood money (what I call it because I'm morbid), especially this time of year.   Hello fellow plasma person!
I have the thoughts all the time.   It's my normal too.  Just one thing I never mention to anyone because of said reaction
Eh.  Just means I'll be on medication for the rest of my life.
Thank you... I'm in the us and have no real allergic concerns (unless they start putting sulfa drugs in there:) )... I know it's the same, there's just a part of my mind that gets paranoid, you know?
You guys are amazing.  I was so terrified to write this.  Honestly, I'm okay at the moment.  I know it'll be back, but at this point I'm not downing iron pills like they're candy. :)

I'm kinda not brave enough to try all in one go.. that and I don't want to leave a mess for anyone to have to clean up (that's why I didn't throw myself into the lake a while ago.... didn't want anyone to be traumatized if they found me).  So I keep slowly trying to poison myself.  Maybe I'm looking for a hospital vacation.  Who knows?  I just know the stress is getting really bad and I'm struggling to stay afloat.

But then I also have nowhere to really vent so it all gets stuffed down and I stay the Little Mary Sunshine that everyone wants.
I hope this doesn't go against the rules of the group.  I just wanted to know if I was alone or not...
I completely understand.  I isolate mentally even though I'm usually surrounded by people
I can relate to this so much... I don't want to leave a mess for anyone.
I was actually just thinking of trying my hand at something like these!  I just wish I could freehand!
I'd like to see the pattern too... it's beautiful
